news.title: Should You Buy NetApp Stock For The Shares It Keeps Retiring?

The stock is not quiet now: it has gained about 92% over the trailing six months and sits roughly 5% below its 52-week high. Fewer shares mean each one carries more of the profit. The question is what that is worth at this price.
